description: Use when an agent needs to search and read in one call. Input: q, optional max (1-10, default 5), time_range (day, week, month, year). Output: JSON results (title, URL, date) and, for the top 3, the page converted to Markdown (up to 4,000 characters each; a page that fails is marked, the rest still ship). Provider failure is not charged. Example: ?q=EU+AI+Act+timeline&max=5 Price: $0.02 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

time_range.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year

name: web_search_read
title: Web search + read: top results with page text as Markdown
